# Neytra Intelligence

> The Neytra Intelligence Platform (NIP) is an AI-powered, enterprise-oriented execution platform designed to transform business objectives into coordinated, controlled, and verifiable workflows.

Neytra Intelligence develops the NIP enterprise execution platform.

## Official website

https://neytraintelligence.com/

## Neytra Intelligence Platform (NIP)

NIP is an intelligent execution platform designed to turn goals into controlled, observable and verifiable work across agents, models, tools, applications and operating systems.

Core concepts include:
- Goal-driven agent execution
- Multi-task orchestration and dependency graphs
- Planning and deterministic execution
- Agent placement and worker lifecycle
- Model and provider abstraction
- Capability and tool discovery
- Authorization, policy and security boundaries
- Observation, critique, reasoning and verification
- Execution attempts, leases and fencing
- Checkpoints, recovery and replanning
- Developer intelligence
- OS-agnostic execution with future Neytra OS integration

## Architecture

NIP separates intelligence from any single model, application or operating system. Its target lifecycle is:

Understand → Decompose → Plan → Discover → Select → Authorize → Execute → Observe → Critique → Reason → Verify → Recover / Replan → Learn
